## What changed and why

Describe the change in a sentence or two. Link the issue if there is one, for example `Closes #12`.

## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request targets `develop`.
- [ ] I built and installed the widget and checked the change by hand (`./build.sh`, `./install.sh`).
- [ ] New or changed strings go through `i18n()` and I ran `translate/update.sh`.
- [ ] The commits follow Conventional Commits.
